assessment: Brodbeck et al. offer a timely and important contribution to how neural signals in response to continuous temporal modulations (as seen in speech and language processing) can be modelled effectively using temporal response functions. They offer a compelling new approach that includes a novel application of a boosting algorithm in addition to an accessible and didactically useful toolbox for analysis. A comparison of boosting and ridge regression via simulation shows the important impact on methods in speech and language neuroscience, as well as in cognitive neuroscience more broadly.
